blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., imper. sg.) по дороге!.
exercises.why: **вези** — imperative (ты, singular) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Двое ли вы ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., pres. 2nd pl.) меч?
exercises.why: **несете** — present tense (2nd person plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).
